description: These trails wind their way through stands of Douglas-fir and lodgepole pine above the community of 100 Mile House. The 99 Mile Hill is home to several trail networks for a variety of recreation activities, including cross-country skiing, snowmobiling, and horseback riding. The area also provides opportunities for the public to tour through a demonstration forest with interpretative signs.
directions: From 100 Mile House, drive approximately 2 km south on Hwy 97 and turn right onto Ainsworth Road. Travel about 2.3 km to the trailhead and parking area. The trails begin on the opposite side of the road.
